anchor: Which high-level academic caster can use two chosen incantations for free any time they like, swapping one out after a good night's sleep?
I want an incantation I can always fire off without burning my energy reserves, but only at its weakest version unless I pay more. Which feature gives that?
Which area effect makes a cloud that rains corrosive downpours, drops hail, and throws electric bolts at six foes over several rounds?
Facing cultists in an open field, I want a sky-mass that booms on everyone inside at first, then keeps raining punishment for many turns. What could I cast?
Which minuscule woodland creature with one hit point and a weak bite can climb at 30 feet and see in the dark?
Is there a pint-sized beast with armor rating 13 that sees 60 feet in darkness and dies from a single point of harm?
For a scholarly mage, which mental stat powers their magic, and can a book of formulas serve as the channeling trinket?
How many formulas can a level 3 arcane user keep ready, and may they reshuffle that list after a full night's sleep?
Which floating crystal circling your head can hold up to four levels of others' magic, letting you unleash it later at their difficulty number?
Is there a gem that circles my head, adds 2 to my physical might up to a cap of 20, and ends my need for food?
Which small beast gains an edge on attacks against a target when its buddies stand within 5 feet of that target and can scale walls at 30 feet?
A monkey-like pest with only 3 hit points ambushed me while its pals hovered nearby. Which creature is it?
Which short sturdy humanoid sees 120 feet in the dark, shrugs off toxins, and can feel tremors through rock?
Is there a folk who gets an edge on rolls to end being sickened by venom and gains extra hit points with each level?
Which eighth-level charm lets me treat any social roll as a 15 for an hour and makes lie-detecting magic read me as honest?
I'm about to talk my way past a guard with truth-sensing magic. What high-level option makes my words pass as honest to it?
Which attuned garment lets me scale ceilings, shrug off snares, resist venom, and conjure a double-size net once per day?
Clinging threads keep catching me in dungeon fights, but my outfit lets me push through them as if they were rough ground. Which attuned item is that?
Which feat lets my bare-fisted hit also seize a foe once per turn, and gives me an edge on attacks against anyone I'm holding?
At character level 4 or higher with a 13 in Strength or Dexterity, which feat lets me haul a creature my size without spending extra movement?
For a visible ally within 60 feet, what quick restorative trick gives 2d4 plus my casting modifier in hit points?
My ally is nearly dead mid-fight and I have only a minor action left. Which low-level magic can help, and does it grow stronger when cast from higher levels?
Which large chaotic monster that speaks the elven tongue suffers penalties in daylight and can hurl poison from 120 feet away?
Is there a monstrous foe with a giant-insect lower half that climbs ceilings and sometimes conjures darkness or sticky strands as a quick extra move?
If I use a higher-level magic slot to make corpses fight for me, how many extra servants per level, and must each corpse be separate?
My party is outnumbered and I still have a fourth-rank casting reserve plus several fallen foes nearby. Could I turn those into minions, and how many can I command?
Which quick trick lets me blink up to 30 feet to an empty spot I can see, wrapped in silvery fog?
Surrounded by enemies, I want to vanish in one swift motion and reappear within thirty feet on an open square. What option does that?
Which life-draining attack deals 8d8 harm on a failed toughness roll, and plant creatures can't resist it at all?
I want to shrivel an ordinary bush or tree instantly, without any roll, from thirty feet away. Which magic does that?
Which legendary heavy weapon flies back after being hurled, stuns nearby foes, and slays giants on a 20 if I wear giant-strength gear?
Is there a top-tier weapon with five uses that I can hurl for a shock wave and that regains some uses each dawn?
Which fighting-style boost adds plus two to hits with launched weapons like bows, for characters who already have a fighting style?
My fighter wants a feat that improves shots at range by two, and I've already got a combat specialty. What feat is that?
Which random-roll mishap from a worn item leaves me toxin-sick for an hour, or turned to stone until the end of my next turn?
I rolled a high number on my headwear and got a fit of magical sickness lasting an hour. What item is that?
Which rare mail-type armor counts as training for me even if I lack medium or heavy proficiency and gives plus one to armor class?
My ranger only trained in light gear wants to wear linked-ring armor. Is there a rare version that makes it usable and adds to AC?
Which set of four metal hoof plates lets my mount hover a few inches over water or lava, leave no tracks, and travel 12 hours daily without tiring?
My steed crosses a swamp without leaving prints or slowing. Is there magic gear for that, one that also cuts weariness on long rides?
Which touch-range magic lets me mold a rock slab up to five feet in any direction into a statue, a latched door, or a passage through a wall?
Trapped behind a barrier of rock, I want to carve a tunnel within a single action, or seal a door shut for good. Is there a magic option?
Which shimmering barrier has a seventh-tier layer that sends a failing creature to another plane, and a sixth-tier layer that a blazing sunlight glare can destroy?
A layered magic field traps a creature: one tier turns it to a statue unless it passes three tries to shake off restraints, while another blinds it. Which option?
Which concentration-based lift can raise a creature or loose object up to 500 pounds twenty feet into the air, and gently lower it when I stop?
My ally fell into a sinkhole; can I hoist them upward and then nudge their height by up to 20 feet on each of my turns?
Which capstone arcane feature lets me pick two third-tier incantations I always have ready, each castable once for free until a rest?
In a long fight I need a free burst of my strongest tier-three incantations, but once used it resets only after a short breather. Which capstone feature is that?
Which large wild animal moves 40 feet per turn, bites and claws each round, and can knock smaller foes flat?
Is there a barely clever creature with 22 hit points, Strength 17, and challenge rating 1 that sees 60 feet in darkness?
Which holy warrior feature lets me unleash a holy strike without using a magic slot, once until my next full rest?
My holy warrior is in a fight and needs an extra burst of holiness but is out of magic slots. Which class ability?
Which celestial messenger can twice per day mend injuries, lift a lingering ailment, or break a curse?
Could a monster heal allies and lift hexes, limited to two uses every day?
Which wondrous item lets me spy on distant people and places with a difficulty of 17 when I touch its clear sphere?
I need remote viewing of a faraway ally, but the item must first be bonded to me. What enchanted item offers that?
Which concentration magic turns a creature into an animal no more dangerous than itself, forbids speaking and casting, and grants temporary hit points equal to the animal's?
My foe must pass a mental-resolve roll or be sent into an animal body for an hour, its gear sticking to its new form. What magic is that?
Which touch-range magic lets a willing ally ignore rough ground, resist being frozen in place or bound, and swim as fast as they walk for an hour?
Shackled and held by a grappler, can a one-hour effect let me slip loose by spending just five feet of my speed?
At the top of my martial career, how many blows can I land in a single turn when I decide to fight with my weapons?
Which gargantuan titan-class monster swims 120 feet, shrugs off frost and electric damage, and grabs victims with ten limbs?
Is there a monster that turns failed rolls into successes four times a day and deals double damage to buildings?
Which woodworking kit lets me pry open a door or box with a DC 20 check and crafts items like barrels, ladders, or a movable battering device?
Is there a six-pound kit that lets me hew wood into a ladder or pole using Strength?
Which medium-sized grazing animal can sprint 50 feet per turn and steps away from foes without inviting a free counterstrike?
What animal with 4 hit points, a keen Perception of plus 4, and a headbutt dealing 2 blunt damage?
Through which concentration magic does searing energy grow each of my turns, while a creature can hurl its glowing pearl 40 feet before it bursts?
Is there a seventh-tier flame attack that bursts across a 20-foot radius and lights up unattended objects?
Which 10-charge rod grants resistance to flame damage while held, and can cast burning hands for 1 charge or a wall of flame for 4?
Is there a hand-held item that regains 1d6+4 charges each dawn and lets its user unleash a big explosion costing three charges?
Which fey-touched people get an edge against being beguiled and can complete a full night's recovery in four hours of trancelike meditation?
Is there a heritage that reaches 120 feet of sight in the dark, starts with a minor light trick and later adds an outlining glow and a shadow zone?
Which bare-handed fighting path teaches techniques to shove and trip foes, and uses inner energy for self-defense?
Which minor magic lets me swing a weapon and deal holy damage, adding more holy damage at levels 5, 11, and 17?
I'm a caster who isn't strong and wants my magical talent to power one weapon hit this turn. What is that?
At what character level does a rogue's extra backstab damage reach 3d6, and which feature arrives at that level?
For my thief-type hero at level eleven, how big is their extra stealthy damage, and what improved strike ability arrives there?
